mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE(NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.recommendedDate')), ''), '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(idempotency_key, ':', -1), '%Y-%m-%d') ) AS recommended_date FROM learning_ai_async_task WHERE owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND task_type IN (#{sceneMaterialType}, #{sceneRegenerationType}) AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{runningStatus}, #{retryWaitStatus}) AND deleted = 0 AND ( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(payload_json, '$.recommendedDate')) IS NOT NULL OR idempotency_key IS NOT NULL )
